architecture.description: Which Windows the installed agent programs are built for, so an update is offered for the same one and never for the other. Absent from agents built before the second architecture, which are all win-x64.

clockSkewSeconds.description: Agent clock minus the last server time seen; provisional field.

firewallProfiles.description: Each firewall profile on or off, as last seen by the agent's firewall watcher; compared with the client's firewall policy. Absent until the watcher has looked once (and from agents before milestone 9).

timeZoneId.description: The cabinet's Windows time zone, compared with its site's time zone. Absent from agents before the time operations.

health.description: A small sample of how loaded the cabinet is, for trends: processor use since the last heartbeat, memory in use, and free space on the system drive. Absent until the agent has two readings to compare, and from older agents.

drives.description: Each physical drive's own health report, sent once after the agent's daily drive check (not with every heartbeat), so the server can keep a history and see a drive getting worse before it fails. The same fields as the disk.smart read.

unsignedUpgrades.description: Present, and true, only when this agent was built to accept agent upgrades whose programs are not code-signed (a development build with no code-signing publisher compiled in). The console marks such a cabinet: whoever holds the release key alone decides what it runs. Absent from every production build.
